title: Doc website: Visual bugs on Firefox on SVG
body: **Bug: What is the current behavior?** A lot (all ?) of SVG images do not display properly on Firefox **Bug: What is the expected behavior?** To have the same visuals as in Chrome 😛 **Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?** Firefox 57
